archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Blue Archive's Japanese Publishing Operations Move to Nexon: October 26, 2026

entries.headline: Phantom Blade Zero debuts at 88 on Metacritic for both PC and PS5
entries.summary: As of 9:00 a.m. Beijing time on October 26, Metacritic listed 54 reviews: 30 for PC and 24 for PS5, with both versions at 88. The report also relays IGN's praise for the combat while noting technical issues.
entries.verification: The opened Denfaminicogamer report records a time-bounded Metacritic snapshot. The scores and review counts are not presented as permanent values.
entries.timeNote: The article was published inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Canceled Mass Effect: Universe reportedly planned to carry forward every trilogy choice
entries.summary: IGN reports that former BioWare technical director Romain Toutain said the canceled project would read choices from the original trilogy and use multiple timelines to handle branching outcomes.
entries.verification: The opened IGN article relays comments from a recent livestream through a third-party translation. It is not presented as a current EA or BioWare plan.
entries.timeNote: IGN's publication time falls inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2's 10th Anniversary Update launches October 27
entries.summary: Bandai Namco and Dimps also set the Final Festival for October 30. The event will bring back hard-to-find items and offer commemorative rewards tied to Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 in 2027.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report explicitly attributes the dates and reward details to Bandai Namco and Dimps.
entries.timeNote: The article was published inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: RTA in Japan Winter 2026 sets its Tokyo schedule for December 25–31
entries.summary: The event opens at 3:00 p.m. on December 25 with a Mega Man Battle Network 4 Any% run, includes a blindfolded Super Mario 64 run on December 29, and closes with Ys VI: The Ark of Napishtim on December 31.
entries.verification: The opened Denfaminicogamer report relays the official RTA in Japan schedule. Session times may move with live event progress.
entries.timeNote: The article was published inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Blue Archive's Japanese publishing operations are set to move from Yostar to Nexon in January 2027
entries.summary: The service will continue, and player data, owned items and unused Pyroxene are expected to carry over. Detailed procedures and maintenance timing will be announced separately.
entries.verification: The opened Denfaminicogamer report attributes the transfer terms to Yostar's representative following the official broadcast.
entries.timeNote: The article was published inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Goddess of Victory: NIKKE's fourth-anniversary update launches October 29
entries.summary: The update opens Main Story Chapters 49 and 50 and starts the MARIA-n event. The anniversary broadcast also showed new trailers and a developer interview.
entries.verification: The opened Denfaminicogamer report reproduces information from a Level Infinite release. The social-trend claim is kept to the scope reported.
entries.timeNote: The article was published inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Report: Elden Ring's live-action film may carry a budget near $200 million
entries.summary: AUTOMATON relays a Wall Street Journal report citing unnamed sources. If accurate, the budget would be far above A24's previous productions; A24 has not confirmed the figure.
entries.verification: The budget is explicitly treated as unconfirmed and traced through AUTOMATON to The Wall Street Journal's unnamed sources.
entries.timeNote: The article was published inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: ファクトリ囲碁 turns Go into a factory-explosion duel built around exhaust ports
entries.summary: The free browser board game uses a Chinese-style stone-counting system. Factories explode when all exhaust ports are blocked, and the full release supports online play without registration.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON feature provides the rules, October 24 release date and itch.io availability, including relayed developer-post details.
entries.timeNote: The feature was published inside this edition's fixed window; the October 24 game release is not reframed as a window event.

entries.headline: Umamusume: Pretty Derby announces Win Marilyn and the new Gosiki Shundai Festival training scenario
entries.summary: A Cygames broadcast introduced the new Umamusume Win Marilyn and disclosed a new training scenario featuring Azuma. This entry stays within the announcement details visible in the opened 4Gamer snapshot.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report confirms the official-program context and the two announcement points. No release date or additional mechanics are added from the truncated text.
entries.timeNote: The article was published inside this edition's fixed window.
